headline: Drake’s verse on “Going Bad” still goes crazy. Does this make your top 5 Drake features Dr
body: Drake’s verse on “Going Bad” still goes crazy. Does this make your top 5 Drake features Drake went so crazy on Meek Mill’s “Going Bad” that I honestly forget it’s not his song sometimes. That verse is just ridiculous from start to finish. He comes in so relaxed and still manages to have some of the hardest lines on the whole track. The beat, the delivery, the bars, everything just clicked. It’s one of those features you can hear a hundred times and still not get tired of.

source_caption_text:
Drake’s verse on “Going Bad” still goes crazy. Does this make your top 5 Drake features 🤔⁉️

Drake went so crazy on Meek Mill’s “Going Bad” that I honestly forget it’s not his song sometimes. That verse is just ridiculous from start to finish.

He comes in so relaxed and still manages to have some of the hardest lines on the whole track. The beat, the delivery, the bars, everything just clicked.

It’s one of those features you can hear a hundred times and still not get tired of. Drake really had one on “Going Bad.”

#drake #meekmill #hiphop
